title: AA-Ecosys doc front-matter
description: YAML front-matter for every page listed in the doc catalog (docs/README.md). Journals (sessions, audits, implementation notes, backlog, research) and ADRs do not use it. Source: S243 docs-standard proposal section 2.1 as corrected by the S243 reconciliation (K-29a to K-29c). Lint: AA-888. Translations (lang, translation_of): S255.

id.description: Catalog ID from docs/README.md, e.g. OPS-02. A page that is one of several under one catalog entry adds a kebab-case suffix, e.g. OPS-02-cis.

title.description: Page title, sentence case, same as the H1.

description.description: Recommended. One sentence an agent reads to decide whether to open the page.

type.description: Diataxis type, plus adr, report and template. A runbook is a how-to with last_tested.

status.description: draft = not yet read by the tech lead or (runbook) not yet run on Dev; active = current truth; deprecated = still true but being replaced; superseded = replaced, see superseded_by; archived = kept for history only.

superseded_by.description: Catalog ID or repo-relative path of the replacement. Required when status is superseded.

owner.description: Slug of whoever is accountable for the page. Company docs name roles, not people; the default slug nghiep stands for the tech lead role.

audience.description: Navigation filter, not an access control. owner = the business owner (CEO).

applies_to.description: Services, apps or versions the page is true for, e.g. aa-cis-api, aa-booking, tripplanner-lambda, ecosystem.

last_reviewed.description: ISO date the content was last checked against the real system. Agents bump it only after a real check (see docs/STYLE.md).

lang.description: Language of the page body. Omit it (or en) on the English page, which is the source. A translation is a sibling file <same name>.<lang>.md that sets its language here (docs/STYLE.md, Language).

translation_of.description: Translations only: repo-relative path of the English page this file translates (docs/guides/ceo.md for docs/guides/ceo.vi.md). The translation keeps the English page's id; check_frontmatter.py checks the pair.

last_tested.description: Runbooks only: ISO date the steps were last executed (Dev, drill, incident or dry run).

tested_where.description: Runbooks only: where the last test ran.

tested_evidence.description: Runbooks only: link to the evidence (Linear comment, docs/audits/<date>-S<nnn>-<slug>/...).

generated.description: true when a workflow writes the page; humans do not edit it.

generator.description: Workflow or script that writes the page, e.g. infra/AA-CIS-Infra/.github/workflows/db-schema-dump.yml. Required when generated is true.

related.description: Catalog IDs, repo-relative paths or Linear issue keys (AA-123) that a reader should open next.

linear.description: PRDs (docs/product/, AA-894): Linear issue keys that deliver this page. tools/docs/check_prd_refs.py requires it on a PRD.

adrs.description: PRDs: repo-relative paths of the ADRs the page depends on. Every path must exist (check_prd_refs.py).

contracts.description: PRDs: repo-relative paths of the cross-app contracts (docs/contracts/) the feature produces or consumes. Every path must exist.

erd.description: PRDs: repo-relative paths of the design or generated ERD pages (docs/architecture/erd/). Every path must exist.

migrations.description: PRDs: paths of the migrations that implement the data model; a path in another repo of the workspace starts with its folder (infra/AA-CIS-Infra/db/migrations/...). Empty until the first migration.
